CustomField.description: Days from today to Target Start Date (or Calculated Start Date if no explicit date). Negative = past due. Drives pipeline bucket assignment. 999 = no date set (stays in 90+ bucket). Recalculates automatically every day.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Requested_Install_Date__c)), Requested_Install_Date__c - TODAY(), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Calculated_Start_Date__c)), Calculated_Start_Date__c - TODAY(), 999 ) )
CustomField.label: Days Until Start
